articles.summary: Results to be issued pre-market open; executives to review results via webcast at 10 a.m. ET. Regions Financial Corp. (NYSE:RF) is scheduled to release its third quarter 2026 financial results on Friday, Oct. 16, 2026. Information will be accessible in the following formats: A news release and additional materials will be made available on Regions’ Investor Relations website at ir.regions.com prior to market open on Oct. 16. Also on Oct. 16, Regions executives will discuss the results via an audio webcast beginning at 10 a.m. ET. The webcast will be accessible in real-time through ir.regions.com and will include an associated slide presentation to be reviewed by company executives. An archived recording of the webcast will be made available within ir.regions.com following the live QA with analysts. articles.summary: Season-long SEC football campaign features interactive fan experiences, coach and student-athlete storytelling, original video content and on-campus activations across the conference. Just in time for the college football season, Regions Bank on Thursday announced a new Southeastern Conference football campaign featuring on-campus game-day activations, fresh podcasts with student-athletes and coaches, a new commercial showing Regions’ pride in the SEC, and digital storytelling celebrating nearly 30 years of Regions serving as the Official Bank of the Southeastern Conference. Regions Bank is debuting a season-long SEC football campaign featuring interactive fan experiences, coach and student-athlete storytelling, original video content and on-campus activations across the conference.
